item.title: How do ecommerce businesses handle reconciliation?
item.summary: I'm building a small prototype for ecommerce reconciliation. The idea is simple: connect Shopify/payment providers/accounting software, match the numbers, and explain why something doesn't match. I'm curious how ecommerce businesses and accountants handle this today. What is the most frustrating part of the process for you?
